gcp.pubsub.throughput.note: Message Delivery Basic per TiB, the same in every region. The first 10 GiB (0.009765625 TiB) a month are free, counted over the billing account ("Every calendar month, the first 10 GiB of throughput identified as the Message Delivery Basic SKU for a billing account is free", https://cloud.google.com/pubsub/pricing). Synced from the Billing Catalog, which lists them as a $0 first tier.
